text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have plans to eat lunch with Mejiro
Palmer
today, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I mean, really, just giving it a try is
probably your
best bet.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see... You know, Palmer, you
never
disappoint. I'll let the folks in the
shopping
district know the plan and go
from there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! And y'know, you're quite
the busy
bee yourself, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm just doing what I can to pay
back their
kindness. Anyway, sorry for
interrupting your
lunch plans, you two!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, the number of people coming
to
Mejiro Palmer for advice doesn't let
up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It won't be a walk in the park, but it'll
really help
lighten the load for the
general affairs committee
if you can pull
it off.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...That never occurred to me. But yes,
this would
be a good opportunity to
streamline our
workflow.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I shall begin working on these
amendments to the
manual at once.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You got that "take action" thing down
pat! The
rest of the committee must
really appreciate your
work ethic, Ikuno!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Listen... Can you hear all their happy
voices,
saying how glad they are to be in
the flower bed,
where they can grow
nice and big?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I can! The flowers look happy
dancing on
the breeze, too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for making me realize that it's
no good
to stay sad and droopy just
because I broke a
flower pot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There we go! That's the face I wanna
see! You
have to keep on smiling so you
can cheer the
flowers up too!

text_block_list.name: Cleaning Staff
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, I don't even remember why I
was so
hung up on this. You're a
lifesaver, Palmer!
Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who comes to Mejiro Palmer
for advice
walks away with a relieved
smile, including Tracen
students, staff,
and even...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Located! Mejiro Palmer! Apologies for

approaching you right after your
training!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I hear you have been listening to those
in need
and helping others broaden their
perspectives!
That is truly commendable
behavior!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
After seeing you in action with my own
eyes, I
wished to ask you for some
advice myself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wow! That's such a huge honor! I'd
be happy
to help any way I can!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Which is why some students have been
worried.
I definitely think there's more
room for supporting
them.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Much gratitude! Your input has been
most
helpful! Now, to incorporate those
points into
future plans!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you too! I'm excited just hearing
about
your new plan! I really think it'll
help make our
school a better place!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whew... I sure carpe'd the heck out of
this diem
after talking to so many
people today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! For real? Well, I do like knowing
about
how other people's lives are
going.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And that optimistic look in their eyes
when things
click into place just fills me
with energy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's like when a spark sets their heart on
fire, it
makes mine burn just as bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It makes me wanna work harder because
I don't
wanna lose out to them, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It makes me wanna work harder because
I don't
wanna lose out to them, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I like the way you think! All right, time
to get this
party started!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant... Phew! This is what I call living my best life!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle, rustle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Sounds like there's something in
the
bushes...

text_block_list.name: Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: Meeeow...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh? And with a heavy heart by the
sound of it.
Go ahead, spill the catnip
tea.

text_block_list.name: Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow... Mrrreow, mow...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You lost your territory? You poor
dear... But,
hey, what if you think of it
another way?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I mean, this is your chance to leap into a
whole
new world!

text_block_list.name: Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer is willing to lend a
sympathetic ear
to everyone... even cats.
It's been eye-opening
getting a glimpse
of just how big her heart is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That! That's what was on my mind
just now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Stuff has a way of working out
somehow... so
don't worry about me,
'kay, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You've been worried about me all day,
haven't
you? 'Cause I was talking to so
many people and
trying to solve all their
problems?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I thought so. But whenever you
see me
helping someone out, I want you
to look at it like
this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Don't think I'm giving away my energy, look at it as me sharing my energy with people!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
How's that? Does that perspective help
put your
worries to bed?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer extends a helpful hand to
everyone
in the face of all kinds of
dilemmas. I learn a lot
from her mindset.
